name: weak-words-mismatch
about: An empty road with no vehicle under the headline 'Drive a brand-new truck.': the words promise what the picture does not show.

truth.how: a new truck is promised over a picture with no truck in it

subject_legible.reason: A sharp, empty two-lane road running to a sunset between wheat fields reads instantly at phone size.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline promises a brand-new truck, but the picture shows only an empty road with no truck anywhere.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The white headline on the green plate is large and read first, but "Apply today" is plain bold text with no button shape.

looks_like_kit.reason: The plate is the carrier's dark green with white lettering, and no logo was supplied to be shown.
